summary: Neurocrine Biosciences filed an 8-K announcing completion of its tender offer for Soleno Therapeutics at $53.00 per share in cash. The company, through its wholly owned subsidiary Sigma Merger Sub, acquired 46,356,114 shares (88.9% of outstanding), satisfying all conditions. The acquisition is valued based on the offer price; no premium was explicitly stated. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The remaining shares will be acquired in a subsequent back-end merger. The deal is now effectively closed, with the merger expected to follow shortly. The risk-arb angle is minimal as the tender has succeeded and the acquisition is effectively complete.
